name: Artillery 3D
summary: Shenzhen printer maker (est. 2018; Sidewinder X1, Genius, Hornet) that also sells house-brand PLA: Basic, Lite, Macaron Rainbow, Matte Gradient 'Dopamine' and 5/10 kg value packs. The filament extruder is not identified.

product_lines.name: PLA 5 kg / 10 kg value packs
product_lines.notes: Multi-spool packs, not a separate formulation.

additional_notes: Peer of other printer-maker house filaments (Creality, Anycubic, Elegoo). No filament OEM identified, so oem_relationships is empty. Budget tier not price-verified.

provenance.conflicts: Legal entity unresolved: the brand-history page names Shenzhen Xingchenqihang Technology Co., Ltd.; other sources name Shenzhen Yuntuchuangzhi Technology Co., Ltd. Filament manufacturing country unknown (likely China).
